prompts.prompt:
Create one production concept image for the Career World project landmark "Kaizen Agent Platform". This is a supporting project building: highly detailed and distinctive, but clearly smaller and less ceremonial than an employer city capital. Research-grounded domain summary: A governed MCP capability platform generated from product-owned API contracts, forwarding calls to authoritative services while preserving identity, RBAC, replay-safe writes, auditability, correlation, telemetry, and failure handling. Accepted baseline identity: Three interlocked stepped workshop bars surround a guarded central transfer bay; a narrow overhead gate bridge and a compact rollback side vault create a controlled, reversible silhouette.

Exploration 1 — Canonical Amplification: refine and amplify the accepted baseline geometry while preserving its defining silhouette. Specifically emphasize this researched quality: contract-owned capability discovery. Use only high-level architecture supported by the project walkthrough; do not invent private endpoints, customers, metrics, or confidential workflows.

One isolated complete asset in exact orthographic 2.5D isometric perspective, viewed from above at a consistent three-quarter angle. Grayscale only: neutral black, white, and gray with no color tint. Dark near-black technical drafting background with a faint isometric grid. Restrained architectural wireframe line art, matte low-value faces, crisp traced edges, fine parallel construction lines, controlled dense detail, no glow. One image only: no second panel, thumbnails, inset, silhouette swatch, contact sheet, before/after, or detached props. Center the whole coherent structure with generous margin. All roofs, stairs, bridges, annexes, and masses must be buildable and physically connected. No words, letters, numbers, signage, logos, brand marks, UI, charts, arrows, people, vehicles, landscapes, photorealism, fantasy, or real-world facility resemblance.
